name: Onlook
oneLiner: 开源、本地优先的设计桌面应用：在真实代码仓库上叠一层画布，用你已有的 Claude Code 或 Codex 账号直接改真实文件，每次改动都是可审查的 PR
oneLinerEn: Open-source, local-first desktop design app that puts a canvas on your real repo and uses your existing Claude Code or Codex account to edit real files, with every change landing as a reviewable PR.
